description: Create a folder, at the top level or inside another one as a sub-folder. Returns its id. Two folders can have the same name, so check list_folders first rather than making a second one by accident. Never use em dashes or en dashes in a folder name. Ordinary hyphens are fine.

name.description: The folder's name, as it will read in the sidebar. At most 80 characters.

parent_id.description: The folder this one goes inside, as returned by list_folders. Omit it for the top level.

name: scratchpad_create_folder
title: Create folder
